description: Define the desired-state, authority, secret-reference, storage, network, lifecycle, backup, and rollback contract for provisioning a private arr stack without committing deployment state.
acceptance: Desired state explicitly models target platform, services, immutable image references, UID/GID, config/download/media paths, network exposure, restart policy, backup policy, and secret references without credential values.
SSH, sudo, Docker, filesystem, and service-API authority are distinct and fail closed when not explicitly granted.
Unsafe path overlap, ambiguous filesystem identity, unpinned images, plaintext secrets, Docker-socket injection, and unsupported exposure modes are rejected.
Synthetic public-safe examples validate without real hostnames, addresses, paths, or household configuration.
